generic_solutions.name_es: Forjado de viguetas C18 con tablero estructural P4 y capa de compresión ligera
generic_solutions.description: Forjado tradicional con viguetas de madera aserrada de pino silvestre C18 de 70x70 mm a 600 mm, tablero estructural de partículas P4 de 30 mm, membrana bicapa fonoabsorbente, conectores madera-hormigón, malla B500T y capa de compresión de 40 mm de hormigón ligero HL-25/B/10/XC2.

properties.supporting_system: direct support on structural element (CYPE EMF020 family)
properties.connection_assembly_method: galvanized staples for board; timber-concrete connectors; B500T mesh; in-situ lightweight topping
properties.delivery_form: individual timber joists, structural boards, membrane, connectors and reinforcement; concrete delivered for site casting
properties.factory_completion_level: componentized system assembled and completed on site
properties.assembly_method: dry placement/fixing of joists and board, membrane and connectors, then reinforced lightweight concrete topping

attribute_calculations.total_depth_mm: 70 mm joist depth + 30 mm board + 5 mm membrane + 40 mm topping = 145 mm

energy_performance.source_reference: VIVA Fase 3 scope: operational energy is scored only for ENV.FAC, ENV.CUB and ENV.VEN.

assessment_notes.total_depth_mm: calculated from sourced sequential dimensions; no allowance added for finishes or tolerances
assessment_notes.energy_performance: Not applicable in the current VIVA Fase 3 operational-energy optimization scope; only ENV.FAC, ENV.CUB and ENV.VEN are scored for this metric.

generic_solutions.name_es: Forjado de viguetas de madera laminada GL24h 60x200 mm con tablero estructural P4
generic_solutions.description: Forjado tradicional a intereje de 60 cm con viguetas de madera laminada encolada homogénea de pino silvestre GL24h de 60x200 mm, tablero estructural de partículas P4 de 30 mm, membrana bicapa fonoabsorbente de 5 mm, conectores madera-hormigón, malla B500T y capa de compresión de 40 mm de hormigón ligero HL-25/B/10/XC2.

properties.connection_assembly_method: galvanized staples for P4 board and screwed timber-concrete connectors; B500T mesh; cast lightweight topping
properties.delivery_form: glulam joists, P4 boards, membranes, connectors and reinforcement as components; lightweight concrete delivered for site casting
properties.factory_completion_level: factory-produced components with site assembly and wet completion
properties.assembly_method: place joists and board dry, fix membrane/connectors/mesh, then cast and cure lightweight concrete topping

attribute_calculations.total_depth_mm: 200 mm joist depth + 30 mm board + 5 mm membrane + 40 mm topping = 275 mm

source_references: CYPE Generador de Precios EMF020 current indexed GL24h 60x200 mm, P4 30 mm variant, 127.36 EUR/m2
legacy STR-SLB-MAD-002 used only as an explicit proxy for full-system GWP and as the component-classification basis for industrialization

environmental_performance.source_reference: proxy from legacy CYPE EMF020 system STR-SLB-MAD-002 because no full-system A1-A3 EPD was found for the GL24h variant; same assembly family but different joist product/quantity

economic_performance.source_reference: CYPE Generador de Precios EMF020 current indexed GL24h 60x200 / P4 30 mm variant

industrialization_performance.source_reference: current CYPE EMF020 cost decomposition; industrialized/non-industrialized component classification transferred from supplied legacy EMF020 decomposition, with GL24h joist cost substituted
industrialization_performance.industrialized_component_classification_: inferred from the supplied legacy EMF020 industrialized flags; not inferred from material alone

energy_performance.source_reference: VIVA Fase 3 scope: operational energy is scored only for ENV.FAC, ENV.CUB and ENV.VEN.

assessment_notes.environmental_performance: explicit proxy required to keep a numeric schema metric; not presented as a CYPE-published GWP for the GL24h variant
assessment_notes.industrialization_performance: ratio calculated from current cost values; industrialized component flags are inferred from the exact same EMF020 component roles in the supplied legacy catalogue
assessment_notes.surface_mass: not assessed; no defensible full-system mass was derived
assessment_notes.energy_performance: Not applicable in the current VIVA Fase 3 operational-energy optimization scope; only ENV.FAC, ENV.CUB and ENV.VEN are scored for this metric.
